title: Dormancy stabilizes non-transitive competitive dynamics
summary: Competitive interactions can maintain diversity, yet coexistence is often fragile in well-mixed populations, where stochastic fluctuations can lead to extinction. This is the case in non-transitive systems, such as rock-paper-scissors dynamics, where no single type dominates globally. While spatial structure can stabilize these systems by providing refuges in space, it remains unclear whether analogous mechanisms can operate in time in well-mixed environments.
